name: The Royal Romance
source:
Love awaits in the royal court of Cordonia. Travel to the beautiful kingdom of Cordonia with the Crown Prince. Will you accept his royal proposal, or will another suitor command your affections?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Royal_Romance,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
科多尼亚王宫里等待着爱情。与王储一起前往美丽的科尔多尼亚王国。你会接受他的皇室求婚，还是另一个追求者会控制你的感情？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Royal_Romance,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
